source: export default function(pikobot) { pikobot.registerTool({ name: 'word_count', label: 'Word count', description: 'Count words in supplied text.', parameters: pikobot.Type.Object({ text: pikobot.Type.String({ maxLength: 10000 }) }, { additionalProperties: false }), async execute(_callId, { text }) { const words = text.trim() ? text.trim().split(/\s+/).length : 0; return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: String(words) }], details: { words } }; } }); }
